The '''homeworld''' of the [[Sibilaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located in the [[Sibilaar system/Legends|Sibilaar system]] of the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was destroyed by a cataclysm, and the native [[Sibilaari]] survived by creating hardened shelters on the most stable parts of the planet's crust. When the planet was destroyed, the chunks of crust were flung out into space, carrying the shelters with dormant Sibilaari safely inside.
